cells: A whisper echoes in your mind; a feeling of being watched; a demand for your true name
A whispering voice echoes in your mind
asking for your true name. You feel a sudden headache as the entity tries to forge a mental link. You must decide whether to answer or resist.
No physical presence or visible speaker.
The headache throbs in time with the whispering voice.
Make the voice a helpful guide instead of intrusive.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as telepathic entity contact
No One Asks You Are Ignored
People push past you; no one makes eye contact; you are entirely ignored
You stand in a crowded street
but no one asks for your name. People push past you and avoid eye contact. You realize you are entirely on your own in this new world.
No friendly faces or helpful guides.
The crowd physically bumps into you as they pass.
Make the crowd busy but polite.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as total isolation in a crowd
Dust flies off the cover; pages turn rapidly on their own; text glows gold
An ancient book on a pedestal suddenly flutters open. The pages turn rapidly on their own
blowing dust into the air. The text glows gold and imparts knowledge directly into your mind.
No modern tablets or digital screens.
The ancient book feels heavy and smells of old paper.
Make the book a friendly talking grimoire.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as magical grimoire binding
Air shimmers; weight suddenly appears in hand; metal hums with energy
The air shimmers around your hand and a sudden weight appears in your grasp. A weapon materializes
humming with strange energy. You instinctively know how to wield it.
No modern firearms or laser weapons.
The weapon feels perfectly balanced in your hand.
Make the weapon a harmless training sword.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as sudden weapon manifestation
A clear voice speaks; rules are laid out; a mental interface is described
A clear voice speaks in your mind
explaining the rules of your new existence. It describes a mental interface and the terms of your pact. You must listen carefully to understand your kit.
The voice is perfectly clear and cannot be ignored.
Make the voice a friendly tutorial guide.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as audio-only system tutorial
A wax seal is broken; a parchment is unrolled; a mentor explains the contents
A mentor figure hands you a sealed scroll. You break the wax seal and unroll the parchment. The mentor explains the contents
revealing your kit and the responsibilities that come with it.
No modern contracts or printed manuals.
The wax seal crumbles when you break it.
Make the mentor a friendly teacher.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as formal master and apprentice
Your shadow elongates; it detaches from the ground; it whispers a dark bargain
Your shadow elongates and detaches from the ground. It stands before you and whispers a dark bargain
revealing your kit. You must accept the terms to gain the power.
No modern projectors or shadow puppets.
The shadow feels cold and unnatural.
Make the shadow a playful trickster.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as dark entity pact
A crystal pulses rapidly; it shatters into dust; the dust absorbs into your skin
A glowing crystal pulses rapidly before shattering into fine dust. The dust absorbs into your skin
causing a sudden mutation. Your kit is revealed through this painful but empowering process.
No modern syringes or medical procedures.
The crystal dust sparkles as it absorbs into your skin.
Make the crystal a harmless glowing candy.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as forced magical mutation
Blue energy seeps from the ground; plants glow faintly; magic is drawn from the earth
Blue energy seeps from the ground
revealing the mana veins that crisscross the earth. Plants glow faintly in the presence of this ambient magic. You must draw power from these veins to use your abilities.
No modern power grids or batteries.
The blue energy feels cool and refreshing.
Make the mana veins look like glowing rivers.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as standard ambient mana
A holy symbol glows; a feeling of righteous purpose; power is granted by a deity
filling you with a feeling of righteous purpose. Your power is granted directly by a deity
and you must maintain their favor to keep it. The power source is faith and devotion.
No modern religions or specific real-world gods.
The holy symbol radiates a comforting warmth.
Make the deity a friendly guardian spirit.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as divine magic system
Deep breathing exercises; a feeling of internal heat; power is cultivated from within
feeling a growing internal heat. Your power is cultivated from within your own soul
requiring discipline and focus. The power source is your own life force.
No modern exercise equipment or sports science.
The internal heat feels like a burning ember.
Make the cultivation a peaceful meditation.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as standard cultivation system
A spirit materializes; a bargain is struck; power is borrowed from the spirit
and you strike a bargain. Your power is borrowed from these spirits through formal contracts. The power source is the spirits' willingness to assist you.
No modern legal contracts or lawyers.
The spirit feels ethereal and cold to the touch.
Make the spirits friendly elemental fairies.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as spirit summoner system
A family crest is displayed; a feeling of ancient lineage; power is inherited
A family crest is displayed prominently
and you feel the weight of an ancient lineage. Your power is inherited through your bloodline
passed down from powerful ancestors. The power source is your genetics.
No modern DNA testing or genetics labs.
The family crest feels heavy with history.
Make the bloodline a magical legacy of heroes.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as inherited bloodline magic
A glowing core is extracted; it is consumed; power is absorbed from the monster
You extract a glowing core from a defeated monster and consume it. Your power is absorbed from these cores
making you stronger with every kill. The power source is the essence of your enemies.
No modern supplements or energy drinks.
The glowing core tastes bitter and metallic.
Make the cores magical candies that grant power.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as monster core consumption
A rune is carved; blood fills the lines; power is inscribed into the body
A rune is carefully carved into your flesh
and blood fills the lines. Your power is inscribed directly into your body
requiring pain and precision. The power source is the magical geometry of the runes.
No modern tattoo parlors or needles.
The carved rune stings and bleeds slightly.
Make the runes magical glowing stickers.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as rune magic system
A blue screen appears; stats are updated; power is granted by the system
A blue screen appears before you
updating your stats. Your power is granted and regulated by the system administrator
an unknown entity. The power source is the underlying code of the world.
The blue screen emits a faint hum.
Make the system a friendly magical guide.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as standard litrpg system
A slime is defeated; a small amount of XP is gained; a feeling of slow progress
gaining a small amount of XP. Your growth is slow and incremental
requiring endless grinding. You feel a sense of slow
No modern video game controllers or consoles.
The defeated slime leaves behind a sticky residue.
Make the slimes harmless bouncing blobs.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as endless grinding
Cold water crashes down; deep breathing; a sudden breakthrough in understanding
You sit under a freezing waterfall
practicing deep breathing. Your growth comes from internal enlightenment and mental discipline. You experience a sudden breakthrough in your understanding of your power.
No modern meditation apps or yoga studios.
The cold water numbs your skin.
Make the waterfall a gentle warm shower.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as waterfall meditation
An artifact is found; it crumbles to dust; a massive surge of power is felt
You find an ancient artifact and absorb its energy
causing it to crumble to dust. Your growth comes in sudden
massive bursts of power. You feel a surge of energy course through your body.
No modern batteries or power banks.
The artifact feels cold and heavy before it crumbles.
Make the artifact a magical glowing toy.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as artifact absorption
A trap is triggered; a narrow escape; a feeling of heightened awareness
You trigger a deadly trap and narrowly escape with your life. Your growth comes from surviving dangerous situations

No modern security systems or lasers.
The trap mechanism clicks loudly before triggering.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as trap survival growth
A story is shared; a bond is formed; a feeling of mutual support
You share a story with your allies around the campfire
forming a strong bond. Your growth comes from teamwork and mutual support. You feel a sense of belonging and shared strength.
No modern team-building exercises or corporate retreats.
The campfire provides a warm and comforting glow.
Make the campfire a fun storytelling circle.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as power of friendship growth
A flat voice speaks; no emotion is shown; facts are stated plainly
monotone voice speaks in your mind
delivering information with zero emotion. It states facts plainly
like a bored bureaucrat reading a manual. The voice is efficient but entirely devoid of personality.
No modern robotic voices or text-to-speech engines.
The monotone voice is perfectly clear and unfeeling.
Make the voice sound like a bored but polite teacher.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as monotone system
A loud voice booms; achievements are celebrated; a feeling of being in a game show
enthusiastic voice booms in your mind
hyping up your every achievement. It feels like you are the star of a bizarre game show. The voice is constantly excited and encouraging.
No modern sports announcers or radio hosts.
The enthusiastic voice echoes loudly in your mind.
Make the voice a cheerful cheerleader.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as game show system
A whispering voice speaks; riddles are given; a feeling of mystery
A whispering voice speaks in your mind
delivering information in the form of cryptic riddles and hints. It never gives a straight answer
forcing you to figure things out yourself. The voice is mysterious and frustrating.
No modern fortune tellers or tarot cards.
The cryptic voice is soft and hard to hear.
Make the voice a playful riddle-master.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as cryptic oracle system
A sneering voice speaks; failures are mocked; a feeling of being judged
condescending voice speaks in your mind
mocking your failures and demanding perfection. It treats you like an incompetent servant. The voice is arrogant and highly critical.
No modern snobs or reality TV judges.
The condescending voice drips with disdain.
Make the voice a strict but caring mentor.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as arrogant system
A stuttering voice speaks; static interrupts; a feeling of instability
A stuttering voice speaks in your mind
interrupted by bursts of static. It delivers corrupted information and seems highly unstable. The voice is unreliable and slightly unnerving.
No modern computer crashes or blue screens of death.
The glitching voice causes a slight headache.
Make the voice a silly robot with hiccups.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as corrupted system
A gruff voice speaks; practical advice is given; a feeling of weariness
tired voice speaks in your mind
offering practical but highly cynical advice. It sounds like a veteran who has seen too many battles. The voice is helpful but entirely devoid of hope.
No modern drill sergeants or military jargon.
Make the voice a grumpy but helpful grandpa.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as veteran system
No voice speaks; text appears in vision; a feeling of quiet isolation
No voice speaks in your mind; instead
text simply appears in your vision. The system delivers information silently
leaving you in quiet isolation. The interface is purely visual.
No modern pop-up ads or notification sounds.
The silent text glows faintly in your vision.
Make the text colorful and fun.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as silent text system
No voice speaks; no text appears; a feeling of complete freedom and danger
and no interface. You are entirely on your own in this world
with no guidance or magical assistance. The absence of a system provides complete freedom but immense danger.
No modern survival guides or wikis.
The silence is absolute and unbroken.
Make the world friendly and easy to navigate.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as no system exists
A roaring fire; ale spills on wood; a bard tunes a lute
You enter The Boar and Barrel Inn
a bustling tavern filled with patrons. A roaring fire warms the room
and ale spills on the wooden tables. You can gather rumors and rest here before your next adventure.
Make the tavern a cozy tea shop.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as standard adventurer tavern
A massive bounty board; mercenaries argue; a clerk stamps parchment
You enter the Obsidian Contract Hall
a massive stone building filled with mercenaries. A large bounty board dominates the room
and clerks stamp parchment endlessly. You can find work and allies here.
No modern employment agencies or temp offices.
The clerk's stamp thuds heavily on the parchment.
Make the hall a friendly community center.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as standard adventurer guild
A massive telescope; scholars debate; dusty tomes are stacked high
You climb the tower to the Celestial Observatory
a quiet place filled with scholars. A massive telescope points at the stars
and dusty tomes are stacked high. You can research magic and history here.
No modern universities or internet access.
The scholars whisper to avoid disturbing others.
Make the observatory a fun science museum.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as magical research library
Crumbling statues; scavengers haggle; a rare artifact is displayed
You wander into the Sunken Plaza
a ruined courtyard occupied by scavengers. Crumbling statues watch over the haggling merchants displaying rare artifacts. You can trade salvaged goods here.
No modern flea markets or pawn shops.
The crumbling statues are covered in moss.
Make the plaza a bustling outdoor market.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as ruin scavenger camp
Wind howls; airships dock; merchants shout prices
You arrive at the Floating Sky Dock
a wooden platform suspended high in the air. Wind howls as airships dock and merchants shout their prices. You can travel and trade goods here.
The wooden platform sways slightly in the wind.
Make the dock a magical hot air balloon station.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as fantasy airship dock
Ancient trees loom; druids chant; a healing spring bubbles

The healing spring water is crystal clear.
Make the grove a magical fairy garden.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as druid healing grove
Dust blows; travelers huddle around a fire; a broken wagon rests

No modern military tactics or firearms.
FOUNDER-ONLY / DO NOT INJECT: same SHAPE as standard demon king army

heavy rain obscures vision; gatekeeper is missing; carriage departs quickly
The player arrives at the imposing gates during a torrential downpour. The expected gatekeeper is nowhere to be found
and the carriage driver leaves hastily. The storm ensures that leaving the estate is impossible.
No working phones or easy exit.
The heavy iron gate locks with a definitive clack behind them.
waking on the floor; broken glass nearby; locked door from inside
The player regains consciousness on the floor of a dimly lit study. Shards of glass are scattered nearby
and a quick check reveals the door is locked from the inside. They must piece together how they got there.
No memory of the entire previous day.
The brass doorknob refuses to turn despite their efforts.
mid-meal toast; sudden scream; lights flicker
The player is seated at a grand dining table when the host stands for a toast. Suddenly
a scream echoes from the hallway and the chandelier flickers out. The social facade immediately crumbles.
No immediate revelation of the body.
The soup goes cold as the guests start murmuring in panic.
pressing a loose brick; dusty tunnel; muffled voices
the player presses a loose brick that swings open into a dusty tunnel. Muffled voices can be heard discussing a secret plan nearby. The estate holds many hidden routes.
The dust in the air makes them sneeze
overturned chairs; chalk dust; torn fabric
The player enters the billiard room to find signs of a recent struggle. Chairs are overturned
and a piece of torn fabric is snagged on the table. Someone left in a hurry.
The cue ball is still rolling slightly when they enter.
inspector demands identification; notebook ready; skeptical gaze
A stern inspector demands the player's name upon entering the foyer. He holds a notebook ready and casts a skeptical gaze
clearly suspecting everyone. The player must establish their alibi early.
The inspector aggressively scribbles down the provided name.
host struggles to remember; apologetic tone; offers drink
The elderly host greets the player but struggles to recall their name. With an apologetic tone
they offer a drink to smooth over the awkwardness. It hints at the host's declining mental state.
No malicious intent from the host.
The host smiles warmly once the name is provided.
reporter ambushes player; rapid questions; flashing camera
A nosy reporter ambushes the player in the hallway
firing off rapid questions. A sudden camera flash blinds the player momentarily. The reporter is looking for a headline.
No publication of the story yet.
The reporter jots the name down with a triumphant smirk.
butler blocks path; cold demeanor; checks guest list
An intimidating butler blocks the player's path at the entrance. With a cold demeanor
he demands a name to check against his pristine guest list. He will not let anyone uninvited pass.
The butler crosses the name off his list with a sharp pencil mark.
guest approaches with a smile; playful tone; seeks alliance
A flirtatious guest approaches the player in the lounge with a charming smile. Using a playful tone
clearly seeking a potential ally. They might know more than they let on.
The guest clinks their glass against the player's upon hearing the name.
heir corners player; frantic whispers; demands identity
A paranoid heir corners the player in the library
whispering frantically. They demand to know who the player is and why they are here. The heir trusts no one.
The heir visibly relaxes slightly upon hearing a non-threatening name.
